changelog:
Security Guardian 1.0.3 Changelog

- Introduced enforced Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) via paired iPhone for all high-risk actions.
- Implemented a Three-Zone Incident Response model: Green (Trusted), Gray (Restricted/Isolated), and Hot (Compromised).
- System detects privileged tool calls by non-owners and triggers instant Lockdown Mode.
- Lockdown blocks all privileged actions until manual override and successful 2FA.
- Detailed operational logic and recovery protocol now documented in SKILL.md.
summary: Enforces Three-Zone Incident Response, 2FA via iPhone, and System-Wide Lockdown.
